turns.q: What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
2.0 · AI

Nom Bot 2.0 · AI says:
Once an order has already shipped (which happens after your order deadline passes), it can’t be changed. That’s why we ask that any updates—like rescheduling, changing meals, or canceling—are made before the deadline shown under “Make changes by…” in the Your Next Box section of your account.
